#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MAX_N = 2005;
const int MAX_L = 2005;
const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

int tree[MAX_N];
int fact[MAX_L];

int make_tree(int n) {
    int i = 2;
    while (true) {
        if (i >= n * 2) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                tree[j] = 0;
            }
            break;
        } else {
            i *= 2;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void update(int i, int x) {
    i += MAX_N / 2;
    tree[i] = x;
    i /= 2;
    while (true) {
        if (i == 0) {
            break;
        }
        tree[i] = tree[2 * i] + tree[2 * i + 1];
        i /= 2;
    }
    return;
}

int get_sum(int s, int t) {
    s += MAX_N / 2;
    t += MAX_N / 2;
    int ans = 0;
    while (true) {
        if (s > t) {
            break;
        }
        if (s % 2 == 0) {
            s /= 2;
        } else {
            ans += tree[s];
            s = (s + 1) / 2;
        }
        if (t % 2 == 1) {
            t /= 2;
        } else {
            ans += tree[t];
            t = (t - 1) / 2;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

vector<int> prime_factorize(int n) {
    vector<int> ans;
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
        while (true) {
            if (n % i) {
                break;
            }
            ans.push_back(i);
            n /= i;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (n != 1) {
        ans.push_back(n);
    }
    return ans;
}

int euler_func(int n) {
    set<int> p;
    for (int i : prime_factorize(n)) {
        p.insert(i);
    }
    int x = n;
    for (int i : p) {
        x *= (i - 1);
        x /= i;
    }
    return x;
}

int f(int a, int b) {
    int ans = 1;
    for (int i = a + 1; i <= b; i++) {
        ans *= i;
        ans %= MOD;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    int n, mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    int x = euler_func(mod);
    int l = n + 5;
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= l; i++) {
        fact[i] = (i * fact[i - 1]) % MOD;
    }
    if (n <= 3) {
        int ans = 0;
        cout << ans << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<int> dp(2000);
    dp[0] = 1;
    dp[1] = 2;
    dp[2] = 2;
    dp[3] = 1;
    make_tree(2005);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        update(i, dp[i]);
    }
    int m = 3;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 3; i++) {
        vector<int> dp0 = dp;
        int ans0 = 0;
        for (int j = i + 3; j < 2000; j++) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= m + 1; k++) {
                ans0 += get_sum(j + k, 2004) * dp0[k - 1] % MOD;
                ans0 %= MOD;
                dp[j] += dp0[k - 1];
                dp[j] %= MOD;
                update(j, dp[j]);
            }
        }
        m += i + 3;
        ans += f(i + 4, n) * ans0 % MOD;
        ans %= MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
